app.name: MyMedia
app.tagline: Your photos and videos, organized in your Google Drive

auth.signInHint: MyMedia only talks to your own Google Drive. Nothing is stored on any other server.
auth.reconnectTitle: Google connection needs to be renewed
auth.reconnectText: Your work is kept and will continue after you reconnect.
auth.scopeDenied: MyMedia needs access to your Google Drive. Please sign in again and tick the Drive permission.
auth.popupBlocked: The Google window could not open. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
auth.configMissing: The app is not configured yet: the Google client ID is missing in config.json (see the setup guide).

setup.title: Welcome to MyMedia
setup.noRoot: No "{{name}}" folder was found in your Google Drive. MyMedia will create it.
setup.rootMissingText: The "{{name}}" folder was deleted or moved to the trash in Google Drive. Restore it from the Drive trash, or create a new one.

folders.moveWith_other: Its {{count}} files and its albums go with it.

folders.deleteText_two: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.deleteText_other: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.exists: A folder with this name already exists here.

gallery.emptyHint: Add photos or videos to the "{{name}}" folder in Google Drive, then press “Load new files”.

sync.scanning: Reading your Drive folders… {{done}} files found
sync.movingHint: Photos already filed in MyMedia that Google Drive is putting in their folder in the background. You can carry on; without a connection it is done later.

viewer.shareFailed: Sharing could not be done. Check the connection and try again.
viewer.cannotPlay: This video cannot be played in this browser.
viewer.cannotShow: This photo format cannot be shown in full quality in this browser.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rootFolderHint: Renaming changes the folder name in Google Drive.
settings.syncAutoHint: Checks when the app opens, then regularly while it is open.
settings.rescanHint: Only needed if something looks wrong.
settings.clearThumbs: Clear thumbnails, previews and videos kept on this device
settings.thumbPacksHint: The thumbnails of an album come in one file instead of one by one. Untick if albums stay empty on this device.

errors.syncFailed: Loading from Google Drive failed. It will be retried.
errors.metaUnreadable: mymedia.json in your Drive cannot be read. It was not changed. Restore a previous version from Google Drive (right-click → Manage versions).
errors.crashText: An error stopped the page. Your photos and information are not affected. Reload to go on; if it happens again, copy the message below.

classify.introClassify: Media at the root of the main folder, or in a category without an album. Tap the suggested album to move the file there, or choose another one.
classify.introAuto: MyMedia moved these files by itself because it was confident. Check them: confirm, or choose the right album.
classify.novelHint: Resembles no album: maybe a species or album that does not exist yet. Not moved automatically.
classify.noSuggestion: No suggestion (not enough examples, or unreadable photo).
classify.keepHereHint: Leave this file where it is; no more suggestions for it.
classify.autoSetting: Move files automatically when MyMedia is confident
classify.autoSettingHint: Only to albums with at least 3 example photos. Below that, MyMedia only suggests.
classify.rebuildHint: Learning runs by itself in the background after each load.
classify.learningHint: MyMedia studies your photos to recognise new ones. Nothing leaves your device.
classify.newAlbumPick: Tick the photos to put in the new album, then press the button again.
classify.groupHint: Photos are grouped by proposed album. Tap photos to tick them, or tick the whole group, then move them.
classify.waitingAnalysis: Waiting for analysis: the suggestion will come once this photo is analysed.
classify.workingHint: MyMedia is preparing or sorting the photos “Waiting for analysis”. You can keep using the app.

misfiled.title: Possibly misfiled photos
misfiled.button: Photos that look more like another album than their own.
misfiled.computing: Comparing every photo with the albums…
misfiled.hint_one: This photo looks more like another album of its category than its own. If it is in the wrong album, move it: a misfiled photo teaches MyMedia the mistake.
misfiled.hint_other: These {{count}} photos look more like another album of their category than their own. If one is in the wrong album, move it: a misfiled photo teaches MyMedia the mistake.
misfiled.rightPlaceHint: It is in the right album: do not show it again

stats.title: Learning statistics
stats.overall: Overall accuracy: {{percent}} (each photo tested against all the others)
stats.fewHint: With fewer than 3 photos, an album only gets suggestions, never automatic moves.

skip.videoNotHere_one: {{count}} video: compress it on a computer (Chrome or Edge)
skip.videoNotHere_other: {{count}} videos: compress them on a computer (Chrome or Edge)

skip.videoFormat_other: {{count}} AVI videos (cannot be compressed in the browser)
skip.format_one: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photo (conversion to JPEG is off)
skip.format_other: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photos (conversion to JPEG is off)

compress.background: You can close this window: compression continues in the background (progress at the top).
compress.autoTitle: When big new files are found in Drive
compress.autoHint: Files you already had stay as they are: use the Compress button on an album to compress them. Videos are compressed only on a computer.
compress.convert: Convert HEIC and PNG photos to JPEG
compress.videoHint: Video compression needs a computer with Chrome or Edge. On phones, videos wait until the app is opened on a computer.

keep.version: Replace it (Drive keeps the old version about 30 days)
keep.both: Keep it forever in the file’s version history

keepHint.version: Saves the most space. The original can be recovered for about 30 days: in Drive, right-click the file → File information → Manage versions.
keepHint.folder: The original is copied to MyMedia/_Originals/… before compression. No space is saved until you delete that folder.
keepHint.both: The original stays as an older version of the same file, without time limit. No space is saved.

compress.minGain: Keep the file unchanged if it saves less than
compress.offerIntro: These new files are big. Tick the ones to compress:
compress.uncheckedHint: Unticked files will not be proposed again (you can still compress them later with the Compress button).

autoMode.ask: Show me the list and let me choose (recommended)

import.createFolderHintSorted: Unticked, its photos go straight into “{{dest}}”. If there is a model or albums, MyMedia automatically puts each photo into its album (or suggests it in “To classify” when it is not sure).
import.originPathHint: The browser only gives the folder's name. To keep where it was on the computer, paste its full path (in Files: Ctrl+L, then copy).
import.title: Add photos and videos
import.intro: Choose photos and videos from this device, a USB stick or an SD card. MyMedia uploads them to Google Drive with their real date.
import.chooseFolder: Choose one or more whole folders
import.dateHint: The date is taken from the photo (EXIF) or the video recording, else from the file name, else from the file itself — not the upload date.
import.analyzing: Reading dates and checking for duplicates… {{done}} / {{total}}
import.duplicatesHint_one: {{count}} file is already in your Drive (same photo): unticked.
import.duplicatesHint_other: {{count}} files are already in your Drive (same photo): unticked.
import.allImported_one: Nothing new: this file is already in MyMedia.
import.allImported_other: Nothing new: all {{count}} files are already in MyMedia.
import.compress: Compress before upload (faster upload, less space)
import.failedHint_one: {{count}} file was not sent: it is at the top of the list, with the reason.
import.failedHint_other: {{count}} files were not sent: they are at the top of the list, with the reason.
import.intoAlbumsIn: The photos will go into these albums, in “{{dest}}” (an indented album is inside the one above):
import.modeSort: Put everything in “{{dest}}” and let MyMedia file each photo in its species album
import.modeSortHint: The computer's folders are not copied as albums: all the photos go straight into “{{dest}}” (nothing changes on the computer). After the upload and the learning, MyMedia recognises each photo: 85 % sure or more, it goes into its album on its own (check in “Classified automatically”); otherwise it waits in “To classify” with a suggestion, or “New?” if it resembles no album.
import.zipNoMedia: This ZIP has no photo or video.

faces.nameHint: Typing a name that already exists merges the two groups (same person).
faces.facesHint_one: The face MyMedia recognised as this person. If it is not them, tick it to fix it.
faces.facesHint_other: The {{n}} faces MyMedia recognised as this person. Nothing to do if they are right; if a face is not them, tick it to fix it.
faces.toNameHint: Each picture is a group of faces MyMedia thinks belong to the same person. Open one and give it a name: it will be applied to all their photos, and to new ones.
faces.searching: MyMedia is looking for faces in your photos (progress at the top).
faces.noneHint: Faces are searched for during learning, after "Load new files".
faces.introText: MyMedia looks for faces in your photos and videos and groups those of the same person. You give each group a name ("Mom", "Noa"…), then you can see all the photos of a person, and new photos are named automatically.
faces.introPrivacy: Everything happens on this device. Face data is never sent to any service; it is saved only in your own Google Drive (mymedia-faces.json) to share it between your devices.
faces.deleteAllText: All faces, groups and names are deleted from this device and from your Drive (mymedia-faces.json). Your photos are not touched. If recognition stays on, faces will be searched for again.
faces.fixedOthers_one: {{count}} other photo of this person fixed too
faces.fixedOthers_other: {{count}} other photos of this person fixed too
faces.forgetHint: Removes this name from all its photos: its faces become "Unknown".
faces.forgetText_one: The face on {{count}} photo becomes "Unknown" and is no longer named. MyMedia won't put it back in this group. Your photos are not touched.
faces.forgetText_other: The faces on {{count}} photos become "Unknown" and are no longer named. MyMedia won't put them back in this group. Your photos are not touched.
faces.coverHint: To choose the photo that shows this person, tick a single face, then “Photo for this person”.
faces.recheckHint: Removes the name from faces named automatically that do not look enough like their person; they go to “To confirm”.
faces.recheckText_one: {{count}} face named automatically does not look enough like its person. It will lose the name and appear in “To confirm”. Faces you placed yourself do not change.
faces.recheckText_other: {{count}} faces named automatically do not look enough like their person. They will lose the name and appear in “To confirm”. Faces you placed yourself do not change.
faces.recheckNone: Every name given automatically is sure enough: nothing to change.
faces.toConfirmHint: By person: every face is ticked. Untick those that are not them, then “Yes”.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search: name, description, album, person, species…

select.title: Selection
select.newAlbumTitle_one: New album with the selected file
select.newAlbumTitle_other: New album with the {{count}} selected files

facebook.hint: ZIP file: one or more ZIPs of photos and videos (e.g. downloaded from Google Drive: select → Download), imported like a folder, sub-folders included. Or a Facebook export (“Download your information”, HTML format): each photo keeps the date and text of its post. Photos already in MyMedia are unticked. On a phone, prefer ZIPs under 1 GB.
facebook.notExport: This ZIP is not a Facebook export in HTML format (group_posts_and_comments.html not found).
facebook.unreadable: This ZIP file cannot be read.
facebook.speciesHint: When the text of a post contains the name of an album of the destination (a species), the photo goes straight into that album. The others stay in the destination, and MyMedia suggests a species.
facebook.matching: Looking for the photos Katia reduced… {{done}} / {{total}}
facebook.replaceHint_one: {{count}} photo of the ZIP will replace its version reduced by Katia (left picture → right picture). Species, album, date and text stay; Drive also keeps the old version. Untick a line if it is not the same photo.
facebook.replaceHint_other: {{count}} photos of the ZIP will replace their version reduced by Katia (left picture → right picture). Species, album, date and text stay; Drive also keeps the old version. Untick a line if it is not the same photo.

katia.settingsHint: First move Katia's folder (birds / ציפורים) inside the MyMedia folder in Google Drive. MyMedia then reads its myphotos.json: species, date, text and group of each photo.
katia.title: Bring in the Katia data
katia.searching: Looking for myphotos.json in your Drive…
katia.error: Something went wrong. Check the connection and try again: what is done stays done.
katia.notFound: No Katia myphotos.json file was found in your Drive.
katia.nothingToDo: The Katia data is already in: nothing more to do.
katia.moveFirst: Katia's folder "{{name}}" is not in MyMedia. In Google Drive, drag it into the MyMedia folder, then come back here.
katia.toReview_one: {{count}} photo without a species: it stays in the category, MyMedia will suggest one ("To classify")
katia.toReview_other: {{count}} photos without a species: they stay in the category, MyMedia will suggest one ("To classify")
katia.unmatched_one: {{count}} photo of the folder is not in myphotos.json (unchanged)
katia.unmatched_other: {{count}} photos of the folder are not in myphotos.json (unchanged)
katia.trashEmptied_one: Move the Katia folder that will be empty to the trash
katia.trashEmptied_other: Move the {{count}} Katia folders that will be empty to the trash
katia.safe: Photos are moved, never copied or deleted. myphotos.json stays in Drive. A photo you already filed yourself in MyMedia is not moved.
katia.keepOpen: Keep MyMedia open and the screen on. If it stops, open this window again: filing resumes where it stopped.

transfer.title: Transfer to another account
transfer.settingsHint: Copy or give a category or an album (e.g. ציפורים) to another Google account, with species, texts and dates.
transfer.searching: Looking for transfers sent to this account…
transfer.noneReceived: No transfer waiting for this account.
transfer.accept: Accept and add to my MyMedia
transfer.accepted_one: Done: {{count}} item is now yours, in your MyMedia.
transfer.accepted_other: Done: {{count}} items are now yours, in your MyMedia.
transfer.sendHint:
How it works:
1. Here, tick what you send, choose “Copy” or “Give”, type the other person's Gmail address, then click the button.
2. The other person gets an e-mail from Google.
3. They open MyMedia with their own Google account, click their photo at the top of the screen, choose “Send or receive a transfer”, then click the button next to what you sent.
Until they do, nothing changes for you: your photos stay in your MyMedia.
transfer.choose: Tick one or more categories or albums (▸ shows a category's albums).
transfer.everythingHint: All of MyMedia goes: every category and album, the photos not sorted yet, with species, texts, dates and the people recognised. On the other account they join its MyMedia (categories of the same name are merged, and a person of the same name becomes the same person). What is your account's own stays with you: what was learned, and models bought (the other account redoes or buys them).
transfer.sent_one: Sent: {{count}} item offered to {{email}}. They must now accept it in MyMedia.
transfer.sent_other: Sent: {{count}} items offered to {{email}}. They must now accept them in MyMedia.
transfer.partly: Done, but {{failed}} of {{total}} items could not be handled. Run it again: what is done stays done. Google says: {{reason}}
transfer.gone: The album “{{name}}” is no longer in your MyMedia: it was moved, deleted or already given to another account. Close this window, tap “Load new files”, then choose again.
transfer.notOwner: The folder “{{name}}” does not belong to this account but to {{owner}}. Google only lets you transfer your own files: open MyMedia with {{owner}} to send it, or choose another folder.
transfer.skipped_one: {{count}} item belongs to another account ({{owners}}): it was not offered.
transfer.skipped_other: {{count}} items belong to another account ({{owners}}): they were not offered.

failed.send: Sending could not start (nothing was offered). Google says: {{message}}
failed.accept: Accepting did not complete. Check that sending finished, then try again. Google says: {{message}}
failed.move: The files are yours, but the folder could not be placed in MyMedia. Try again. Google says: {{message}}
failed.peopleNotYet: The photos of these people are not in your MyMedia yet. Accept the photos' transfer first, then this one.
failed.peopleNone: No given photo with recognised people was found on this device or in your account.

transfer.confirmMany: {{folders}} folders ({{count}} photos) will be offered to {{email}}.
transfer.peopleHint: Transfers made before 16 October 2026 did not take the people recognised on the photos. Type the Gmail address above, then click here: the other account gets them under “Received” and accepts them like a transfer.
transfer.peopleSent_one: The people of {{count}} photo were offered to {{email}}.
transfer.peopleSent_other: The people of {{count}} photos were offered to {{email}}.
transfer.modeCopyHint: the other account gets its own copy, you keep everything. If its copy stops, you lost nothing. The photos take space on both accounts.
transfer.modeGiveHint: the photos change owner and leave your MyMedia when the other account accepts. No extra space, but if the other account stops half-way, you must take them back.
transfer.confirmCopy_one: “{{name}}” ({{count}} photo) will be shared with {{email}} to copy.
transfer.confirmCopy_other: “{{name}}” ({{count}} photos) will be shared with {{email}} to copy.
transfer.confirmCopyMany: {{folders}} folders ({{count}} photos) will be shared with {{email}} to copy.
transfer.shared_one: Shared: {{count}} photo for {{email}} to copy. They must now click “Copy into my MyMedia”. Your photos stay with you.
transfer.shared_other: Shared: {{count}} photos for {{email}} to copy. They must now click “Copy into my MyMedia”. Your photos stay with you.
transfer.copied_one: Done: {{count}} photo copied into your MyMedia.
transfer.copied_other: Done: {{count}} photos copied into your MyMedia.
transfer.reconnect: Google asks to renew the connection. Click below: the work goes on where it stopped.
transfer.sharedHint: The other account can see these folders (not change them). Once its copy is made, withdraw the access: its copies stay with it.

models.title: Classification models
models.settingsHint: Use the sorting learned by another account (for example Katia's birds) to sort your own photos, or publish yours. Only the photos' fingerprints are shared, never the photos.
models.intro: A model holds the album names and the fingerprints of an account's sorted photos, without the photos. Once you get it, MyMedia compares your new photos with its examples to sort them, and creates each album when a first photo goes into it. It only works with your Google account.
models.shopEmpty: The shop is empty for now.
models.shopUnreachable: The shop does not answer. Check the connection and try again.
models.installed_one: “{{name}}” is installed: it knows {{count}} album. The album is created when a first photo goes into it.
models.installed_other: “{{name}}” is installed: it knows {{count}} albums. Each album is created when a first photo goes into it.
models.removed: Model removed. Its albums and the photos in them stay.
models.withdrawn: Withdrawn from the shop. Those who already got it keep it.
models.publishHint: Choose a category that has albums (for example ציפורים). The fingerprints of its sorted photos are sent to the shop, with the album names: all of them, up to 5,600 in all (beyond, the biggest albums are limited). Your photos stay in your Drive.
models.name: Model name
models.priceHint: Payment is not plugged in yet: during the test every model is free, the price is only shown.
models.published: “{{name}}” is in the shop: {{albums}} albums, {{count}} examples.

error.tooFew: This category does not have enough sorted photos: at least 2 albums with analysed photos are needed.
error.otherModel: This model was made with another version of MyMedia: it cannot be used.
error.noRoot: The MyMedia folder is not ready yet.
error.signIn: Sign in to Google again, then retry.
error.tooBig: The model is too big to be sent.
error.notPaid: The payment did not go through: nothing was charged. Try again.
error.noPaypal: The seller gave no PayPal account: this model cannot be bought yet.

models.leftOut_one: Album left out (no analysed and checked photo): {{names}}.
models.leftOut_other: {{count}} albums left out (no analysed and checked photo): {{names}}.
models.paypal: Your PayPal account (to receive the money from your sales)
models.priceHintLive: Buyers pay MyMedia with PayPal. MyMedia keeps a {{fee}}% commission and sends you the rest on your PayPal account within 7 days of each sale.
models.youGet: You get {{share}} of {{price}} per sale (MyMedia commission {{fee}}%).
models.salesHint: Amounts after MyMedia's {{fee}}% commission. MyMedia sends them to your PayPal account within 7 days of each sale.
models.payoutsHint: Send each amount in PayPal (Send money, to the address shown) at most 7 days after the sale, then click « Mark as paid ».
models.payoutsNone: Nothing to pay out for now.

account.title: Account
account.reconnectHint: Reconnect: when Google asks to renew the connection (mostly on iPhone). Switch account: open MyMedia with another Google account.

driveImport.buttonHint: Files another Google account shared with you: Google copies them into MyMedia, without going through this device.
driveImport.title: Import from Google Drive
driveImport.hint:
Files and folders other Google accounts shared with this account. Google copies them straight into MyMedia: nothing goes through this device, and the originals stay with the other account.
Not in the list? In the other account's Google Drive, right-click → Share, and add this account's address.
driveImport.none: Nothing is shared with this account yet.
driveImport.emptyFolder: No photo or video in this folder.
driveImport.sortHint: The photos go straight into the destination, and MyMedia files each one in its album (or offers it in “To classify”).
driveImport.collecting: Looking for photos and videos… {{count}} found
driveImport.dups_one: {{count}} file was already in MyMedia: it was not copied.
driveImport.dups_other: {{count}} files were already in MyMedia: they were not copied.
driveImport.failed_one: {{count}} file could not be copied. Google's detail: {{reason}}
driveImport.failed_other: {{count}} files could not be copied. Google's detail: {{reason}}

library.title: Library
library.readOnlyHint: {{owner}}'s MyMedia, shared with you to view: you can look, search and download; nothing can be changed.
library.sharedHint: {{owner}}'s MyMedia, shared with you with editing rights: your changes go into their library.
library.searching: Looking for MyMedia shared with you…
library.none: No MyMedia is shared with this account.
library.shareHint: To show your MyMedia to someone without giving them your account: in Google Drive, share the “{{name}}” folder with their Gmail address, role “Viewer”. When they open MyMedia with their account, they find it here, view only.
library.setupShared: A MyMedia is shared with you, you can open it:
library.lost: The shared MyMedia can no longer be reached (sharing was removed): your own library is open.

share.title: Share
share.intro: They can look at, search and download your photos and videos, without your account and without changing anything. They need a Google (Gmail) account.
share.notify: Tell them by e-mail (sent by Google)
share.done: {{email}} can now see your MyMedia: they open {{site}} with that account, then Sharing.
share.invalid: This address does not look valid.
share.removeText: {{who}} will no longer see your MyMedia. The photos stay in your Drive, nothing is deleted.
share.viewIntro: The MyMedia other Google accounts share with you. Open one to look at it; come back to yours here.
share.whatsappHint: Opens WhatsApp with a message explaining how to see your MyMedia; you choose who gets it.

install.title: Install MyMedia
install.ios: In Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an arrow), then "Add to Home Screen". MyMedia then opens like an app.
install.android: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu, then "Install app" (or "Add to Home screen"). If nothing shows, MyMedia may already be installed: look for its icon.
install.desktop: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the end of the address bar, or menu ⋮ → "Install MyMedia". If nothing shows, MyMedia may already be installed.

recover.title: Recover information
recover.hint: If photos lost their import, species, text or people, MyMedia looks for them in the versions Google Drive keeps of mymedia.json (about 30 days). Only what is missing is taken back: nothing done since is changed.
recover.intro: MyMedia looks at each earlier version of mymedia.json and counts the current photos that find information in it. The best one is chosen; you can choose another.
recover.listing: Reading the versions kept by Google Drive…
recover.noVersions: Google Drive kept no earlier version of mymedia.json.
recover.allThere: No earlier version has information missing today.
recover.done_one: {{count}} photo completed and saved to Drive.
recover.done_other: {{count}} photos completed and saved to Drive.

speed.title: Internet connection
speed.failed: The test could not be done. Check the connection and try again.

meaning.offline: No connection: only the saved thumbnails are shown.
meaning.unknown: The speed is not known yet: run a test.
meaning.slow: Slow connection: photos show slowly, videos may stop and imports will take time.
meaning.medium: Average connection: photos show well, videos may take a moment to start.
meaning.good: Good connection: photos and videos show fast.

speed.local: Local version: the file comes from this computer, the speed shown is not the internet's.

reclaim.title: Take back my photos not accepted
reclaim.short: A transfer stopped and the other account can no longer accept? The photos that are still yours come back to your MyMedia, in their place (category, album), with their species and texts.
reclaim.hint: MyMedia looks for the photos that still belong to this account but are no longer in its MyMedia (given to another account that did not accept them). Nothing is moved before you agree.

reclaim.found_other: {{count}} photos of yours are no longer in your MyMedia:

reclaim.done_one: Done: {{count}} photo is back in your MyMedia.
reclaim.done_other: Done: {{count}} photos are back in your MyMedia.

pro.title: MyMedia Pro
